stanza: While all the women came and went

approach.line: I saw the panic as he approached
stanza: He motioned to me from across the street
His arms waving madly "Come over to me"
I saw the panic as he approached
We both ran quickly to the house
Where the windows were shot out

coach.line: So I had to play football for the coach
coach.linePrev: I ever knew was standing right for me all the time
coach.lineNext: And I wanted to play football for the coach
